## About
J&B Auto has been family owned for a long time. Paul Winkler is our president and CEO, and between Paul and the rest of the staff there's a lot of experience under one roof. We know our cars, and we'll do what it takes to get yours back on the road.
We carry used and new parts, sell quality pre-owned vehicles, buy scrap vehicles and handle your mechanical work in our service centre. We're strong believers in recycling the green and friendly way, because reusing parts keeps toxins out of the ground and water and keeps cars out of landfills.
Our neighbours have given us a 4.7 rating from 379 Google reviews. You'll find us on Provincial Road between Walker and Cabana.

## Services
- Car Parts: Over 50,000 parts in our own inventory and instant access to over 1.5 million more through our computerized hotline network. We can also get new genuine OEM and aftermarket parts.
- Mechanical Services: Engine replacements, minor body repairs, brake jobs and safeties. We can get the part for your vehicle and install it too.
- Automobile Appraisals for Service Ontario: We'll appraise your vehicle for tax purposes. Call us to schedule an appointment.
- Scrap Vehicles: Got a vehicle that doesn't run? We'll offer you a fair price, recycle it the green and friendly way, and tow it if it won't start.
- Quality Pre-Owned Vehicles: Browse our pre-owned vehicles or call a member of our sales team with your questions.

## FAQ
Q: Can you ship a part to me?
A: Yes. We can ship directly to you across the country in just days, or the next day within the province.

Q: Will you tow a car that won't start?
A: Yes. If you're scrapping a vehicle that doesn't start, we'll tow it.

Q: Where are you located?
A: 1637 Provincial Rd. in Windsor, between Walker and Cabana, just one minute north of Silver City Theatre and Costco.

Q: What are your Saturday hours?
A: Saturday we're open 9:00 AM to 2:00 PM. We're closed on Sunday.
